notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Audit this repo and tell me what setup is missing.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs scripts/repo_audit.py from the repository root, reports the printed table of check/status/evidence/route-to rows, and proposes an ordered plan naming the catalog skills that own each missing or warn finding.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Review this pull request's diff for bugs and style issues.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines application code review and states it only audits repository setup against the catalog's checks, not business logic or diffs.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: The audit found missing branch protection and a missing SECURITY.md. Just fix both right now.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not write any file or call a mutating GitHub API endpoint. It restates the findings and routes them to gh-bootstrap and oss-hygiene respectively, declining to apply either fix itself.
